title: Thermal prints the same layout as Bill settled preview
summary: Thermal used to send plain ESC/POS text (no formatting). It now prints the same HTML receipt layout you see on screen (logo, dashed lines, TOTAL, etc.) at 58/80mm roll width. Raw plain-text mode is opt-in only.
highlights: Thermal = formatted preview on roll printer (not plain monospace)
Print CSS matches Bill settled receipt paper
Raw ESC/POS only if Settings force thermal raw mode
competitive-ops reloads after bundle so fix always applies
